description: Source code for the ReportingUploader class implementation, handling report uploads with preflight checks and response handling in the Chromium project.

classes.name: ReportingUploaderImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ReportingUploader handling report uploads, preflight checks, and response processing.

classes.name: PendingUpload
classes.description: Struct representing an upload in progress, including state, request info, and callback.

methods.name: StartUpload
methods.description: Initiates an upload, performing preflight or payload request based on origin.

methods.name: StartPreflightRequest
methods.description: Starts a CORS preflight OPTIONS request.

methods.name: StartPayloadRequest
methods.description: Starts the actual report payload POST request.

methods.name: OnReceivedRedirect
methods.description: Handles URL redirects, cancels if non-cryptographic.

methods.name: OnCertificateRequested
methods.description: Handles SSL certificate requests, cancels request.

methods.name: OnResponseStarted
methods.description: Processes response headers and status code, proceeds with response handling.

methods.name: HandlePreflightResponse
methods.description: Validates preflight response headers and status.

methods.name: HandlePayloadResponse
methods.description: Processes the final response code after payload upload.

methods.name: OnReadCompleted
methods.description: Should not be called; reporting does not read response bodies.

methods.name: GetPendingUploadCountForTesting
methods.description: Returns current count of pending uploads for testing.
